instruction.text: Write and work out the estimation calculation. Round the prices to the nearest pounds.

atoms.a:
Jonathan and Priti buy a game for £4.99, a pack of colouring pens for £8.95, two jumpers for £18.89 altogether, and some chocolate muffins for £2.39.

Question: Approximately how much did they pay?

Estimate:

instruction.text: Write and work out the estimation calculation. Round the distances to the nearest ten.

atoms.a:
Miguel travels for work. He put a full tank of petrol in his car, which gives him 380 miles. First, he has to drive 88 miles to Market Harborough, then another 142 miles to Swansea.

Question: Will he have to refuel before he gets to Birmingham (106 `miles`)?

Estimate:

atoms.b: Answer: Miguel ((++won’t will)) have to refuel to get to Birmingham.

instruction.text: Write and work out the estimation calculation. Round the weights to the nearest ten.

atoms.a:
To make a cake, you need 132 g of chocolate, 1 egg (53 g), 265 g of flour and 108 g of sugar.

Question: Approximately how much will the cake weigh?

Estimate:

atoms.b: Answer: The cake will weigh approximately 560 g.

instruction.text: Write and work out the estimation calculation. Round the prices to the nearest ten pounds.

atoms.a:
Sacha is selling muffins to raise money for charity. So far, she has raised £26 from vanilla muffins, £19 from raspberry muffins, £13 from chocolate muffins and £41 from lemon muffins.

Question: Approximately how much has she raised so far?

Estimate:

atoms.b: Answer: Sacha has raised approximately £100 from selling muffins.
